collector.contracts: As-of effective complete contract set with exact activated term/preparation/readiness/review bindings; net from immutable terms, currency from certified immutable activation-baseline/contract linkage; no single-contract shortcut or signed gross used as net
collector.receipts: Confirmed same-project receipts by true receiptDate <= business cutoff; every required row must have immutable v1 receipt_accounting_basis. Gross cash for progress ratio; net for margin. No missing-basis exclusion toggle.
collector.costs: All real registered/current source rows partitioned by actual include/exclude producer; unknown/unclassified remains visible and not implicit zero. Included direct nodes need captured E source facts + active verified F stage and known net currency; payment installments are distinct actual payment IDs.
collector.sourceChains: Server constructs canonicalAccumulationKey from actual primary source identity/lineage and sourceChainKey from real payable link. Invoice/tax-support/evidence-only must exclude primary money; controlled explicit supportingSourceRefs creates actual append-only source link+reason, never amount/date heuristics. Included procurement promise excludes any absorbed same-chain payment principal; no triple counting.
collector.allocations: Use actual F basis/result/source snapshots, exact stored selected-measurement-first-v2 cents/layers. No synthetic ProjectActualCostRecord. Result version and each real source/stage lineage frozen; shared source full amount and same share source-set mutually exclusive; direct source unrelated same-payable installments remain valid.
collector.baseline: One adopted PROJECT technical-cost chain, counted once even across many contracts; original earliest approved adopted package immutable. Current handover cost from exact before/after basis verified chain; execution change delta = approved successor project cost version net minus predecessor net, each transition once. Contract gross/signed delta never cost delta. Forked/disconnected/conflicting adopted project packages reject.
collector.tax: Active F tax snapshots/evidence, deductible VAT excluded from base; non-deductible adjustment only when explicit source component not already included; pending remains unknown/pending, never automatic addition of all taxImpactAmount
collector.labor: yes if any transitive member is labor; no only if all lineage verified non-labor; otherwise unknown and strongest reversible projection/write guards
collector.zero: Known zero only exhaustive source-scope zero or authorized explicit exclusions with proofs; money knowledge separate from maturity/evaluation. Missing confirmed receipt basis or included hard evidence prevents official publish.

inclusion.persistence: Append project_cost_inclusion_decision + CAS project_cost_inclusion_head. Per-snapshot operating_snapshot_cost_member immutable; copying same actual decision into later snapshot does not reinclude or reprice it.
inclusion.directProducer: UPDATE project_actual_cost_record SET record_status='included',is_included_in_project_cost=true,included_at=now(),included_by=actor,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=... AND row_version=expected AND record_status='confirmed' AND NOT is_included_in_project_cost RETURNING ...; exactly one row, after real qualification.
inclusion.includedMeaning: Sticky consumed-ever fact; never reset flag/status to confirmed merely to bypass E/F guards. Live inclusion head can only change through explicit restatement when previously published inclusion changes. Replaced old record remains historical flag=true,status=replaced; original membership never changes.
inclusion.sharedProducer: Do not flip confirmed shared pool source to included as full direct cost. CAS actual F result is_included_in_project_cost=true/included_at/by and increment result row_version, record causal metadata transition; membership consumes only result project share.
inclusion.exclusion: Unconsumed candidate exclude creates reasoned classification only, no included cost flag; explicit registered/no-stage exclusion is pending/not-yet-applicable and H retains gap. New source candidates cannot disappear from exhaustive scope.
inclusion.ordinaryReplacement: E direct labor replace, F stage/tax/whole-allocation replace and C source mutation must check actual consumed membership; normal paths return 409 operating_restatement_required if changing a consumed factual component. No fake reset/uninclude.
inclusion.restatementReplacement: Existing operating-restatements handles live or period roots. Sealed internal RestatementPermit is produced only after true referenced snapshots/source hashes/versions and full affected-project set are locked. It allows actual E labor recalculation and F complete-batch replacement using real business inputs, fresh stage/source proof, predecessor links and all necessary G/H restatements atomically. It is never a client boolean.
inclusion.bound: Unsupported non-labor source correction stays blocked until its real upstream producer exists; G accepts only actual corrected source IDs/versions, never correction money. Do not invent a refund/source row or certify a fixture.
